gate_criteria.description: Measured baseline and explicit scaling triggers are delivered. Additional infrastructure is conditional on evidence, not required speculative work
verified_points: Synthetic tests model bounded capacity policy and Free-tier risk envelopes; live V5 production resource measurements are not yet available.
Warning-threshold rules are implemented and exercised in tests; real post-cutover signals and alerts remain pending.
Scaling action routing is modeled for measured triggers; no production capacity change has been executed.
Negative guard refuses speculative capacity purchase/scaling without actual measurements.
Synthetic policy verifies that unauthorized cost increases are not required; live cost and provider quota acceptance is pending.
